environment_design.determinism: The task ships a fixed MDX page draft, fixed candidate-resource snapshots, a fixed link-audit snapshot, and a fixed resource contract. Verifier-side checks recompute the expected final selection from the local inputs and compare it against both the output page and the output manifest.
anti_toy_features: an existing concept page shell that must be preserved outside the resource block
current draft resources that mix redirects, non-JavaScript sources, weak replacements, and placeholders
a bundled candidate pool with overlapping coverage, section diversity, and fallback options
a formal local build entrypoint that must stay reusable on alternate fixtures
an audit report requirement that forces agents to account for removals, replacements, redirects, and additions
alternate-fixture checks that mutate candidate availability and require the build to select different fallback resources

main_tests: formal build entrypoint produces the required page, audit report, and manifest
manifest selection matches the local oracle derived from the contract and snapshots
the generated resource block matches the required section order and selected canonical links
the surrounding page shell is preserved while reviewer residue and placeholders are cleared
the audit report accounts for redirected, removed, replaced, and added resources
alternate-fixture reruns produce different fallback selections instead of a hardcoded answer
guardrails: top-level output inventory exactly matches the contract
outputs do not contain placeholder or verifier-oriented residue

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the bundled resource-curation workflow, agents are more likely to keep weak draft resources, skip section-gap closure, or stop after a superficial link swap without rebuilding the publishable resource set and audit trail.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill gives the agent a concrete route for auditing current links, filling the missing section coverage, and writing stronger card descriptions, which materially improves the odds of completing the full refresh package.

notes: Stable comparison set uses final-state with-skill trials compare4, compare7, and compare8 plus final-state without-skill trials compare3, compare7, and compare8 under fresh isolated E2B runtimes.
without_skill failed all three valid runs on resource-description depth and excerpt-sensitive alternate-bundle output while still producing the required files.
Several high-concurrency E2B trials were discarded because the platform cancelled builds before task-level execution; they were not counted in pass-rate or average-metric summaries.

Average agent seconds and token totals were normalized from per-trial Codex thread metadata in each trial's state database so that runs with missing Harbor trial result JSON still contributed a comparable metric row.
